blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Ateneo captured the inaugural UAAP women’s badminton team event title under the new format, defeating National University, 3-1, on Wednesday at Gameville Central Park in Mandaluyong City. The Blue Eagles now have an early advantage in their bid for back-to-back crowns and a chance to close in on the University of the Philippines’ record of 10 women’s badminton titles. “I am very happy right now na napakita naming pwede rin naming gawin na kahit wala na si ate Mika (De Guzman),” Ateneo team captain Althea Ocampo said. “Knowing na noong andyan si ate Mika, may one point na agad.
